title: Topic 17
japanese_text:
A：日本史って本当に苦手。こんなに長い<u>年表</u>を見てると、<u>投げ出したく</u>なるよ。
B：まあ覚えることは多いよね。でも、例えばあの有名な織田信長は<u>権力</u>を持っていたけど、実は<u>孤独な</u>人だったとかいう事実を知ると、歴史を<u>さかのぼる</u>のが面白くなってこない？
english_translation: A: I’m really bad at Japanese history. When I look at how long the timeline is, it makes me want to give up. B: Well, there certainly is a lot to remember. But when you learn about, for example, how lonely Oda Nobunaga was despite all his authority, doesn't tracing the course of history become more interesting?
